title: Leather seats and Atlas Grey interior trim
summary: Feedback on this topic centers on appreciation for Merino leather comfort and Copper Brown/Atlas Grey interior colors, alongside requests or uncertainty about genuine leather availability and trim quality.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the comfort of Merino leather seats, the Copper Brown/Atlas Grey color combination, and easy seat entry and exit.

negative.summary: Negative feedback says the vegan seats feel like a downgrade from previous leather seats and are disappointing by comparison.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention missing or non-genuine leather, lower perceived leather quality, dashboard trim concerns, and sliding, but the examples do not always state a clear overall sentiment.

limitations: Most examples are undetermined, so the topic signal is dominated by mentions of leather materials and trim without consistently explicit sentiment.
The cluster mixes seat material, interior color, dashboard leather/trim, and sliding-related comments, so it is not fully coherent as a single issue.
Some positive evidence includes stated willingness to pay for leather or a brown dash rather than direct satisfaction with the current vehicle configuration.
